resources.string: Your saved billing details are sent to the payment sheet, so only the card number, expiry and security code need typing. Everything stays editable.
The same payment, driven from a Java Activity instead of a Kotlin one. It exists so the SDK\'s Java interoperability is proven by something that actually launches a payment, not only by a unit test.
Succeeded — %1$s\n\nAdvisory only. Confirm with your backend, which knows the webhook outcome, before fulfilling anything.
Failed: %1$s\n\nNothing was charged. The customer can try again.
Pending — the payment may still be live.\n\nDo not retry it, do not refund it, and do not release the order. Wait for the webhook.
